remarks: Newer 1 bedroom apartment. End unit. Only 2 residential apartments in this building of predominately commercial office space. Monthly rent includes heat, air conditioning, electric, water, hot water, trash. Tenant pays for credit and background check, cable/internet service if desired and renter's insurance which is required. Apartment includes gas range, microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator, stack washer/dryer, and window blinds. Two cars allowed. One of the two parking spaces shall be assigned. No trucks allowed. No pets and no smoking permitted. Tenant must have acceptable credit and references and must provide proof of adequate income. Two-month security deposit required (Only 1 month required if 62 years old or older). Apartment has its own patio. Grilling is not allowed on the patio.
